pricing_copy: Inspect, enter and correct stored market observations.
pricing_saved: Observation saved. Valuation reads have been refreshed.
pricing_coverage_copy: Dated diagnostic using current recorded knowledge. An observation older than {days} days is marked stale here.
pricing_consumer_limits: Holdings retain labelled old prices; FX reports reject prices outside their dated window (seven days by default). Coverage here uses the configured diagnostic age limit.
pricing_coverage_empty: No configured price pairs yet. Choose a pair for manual entry.
pricing_missing_copy: No non-retired observation exists on or before this date. Add a manual observation or check FX provider settings.
pricing_history_copy: Newest recorded observations first. Valuation dates can differ from recording dates. Retired evidence remains available.
pricing_choose_pair: Choose two distinct instruments to inspect their history.
pricing_history_empty: No observations for this pair. Manual entry is available above.
pricing_derived_warning: Derived rate; source-leg dates may differ
pricing_mutation_copy: This changes market valuations only. Posted transactions, cost basis and reconciliation checkpoints stay unchanged. The original evidence is kept.
pricing_correction_copy: Correction keeps the same pair and valuation date, withdraws derived dependencies, and records a manual replacement. For a different date or pair, withdraw and add separately.
pricing_amount_hint: Enter a positive amount using the selected language’s number format, with up to 18 decimal places.
pricing_retire_list: These observations will be withdrawn, including derived rates:
pricing_stale_review: Observations or dependencies changed. Your input is kept; review again before saving.
pricing_invalid_amount: Enter a positive exact amount within the supported range.
pricing_basis_hint: Unadjusted prices value your holdings. Total-return prices include reinvested income and serve only as a returns benchmark.
pricing_basis_kept: A correction keeps the adjustment basis of the price it replaces.
quotes_scope: Enter priced holdings with lots. Exchange connections, DeFi, staking and NFTs are unsupported.
quotes_empty: Add an instrument, then create a holding account to record trades.
quotes_identity_help: Enter exact provider identities. Save changes before enabling quotes. Currency and market must match the provider response.
quotes_provider_help: Quotes use your saved daily schedule. CoinGecko requires an operator Demo key; Twelve Data requires a key and suitable market/display entitlements. Yahoo is unofficial with no service guarantee.
quotes_refresh_health: Refresh quotes and inspect provider health
quotes_opened_help: Choose the actual opening date, on or before your earliest trade.
quotes_csv_help: Choose the crypto holding and cash account. Upload UTF-8 comma CSV with the columns below. Dates use YYYY-MM-DD; side is BUY or SELL; quantity and cash amount are positive dot-decimal magnitudes. Use a unique external_ref for every trade. Amount is net settlement; no fee breakdown is inferred.
quotes_queued: Quote assignments queued: {count}. Check provider health for results.
pricing_filter_missing: Showing pairs without a usable price.
pricing_filter_stale: Showing pairs valued from an earlier day.
